headline_finding: The complete-case Spearman of 0.288 has a 95% site-bootstrap interval of [-0.058, 0.536], which includes zero. With 9 measured sites the correlation is NOT statistically distinguishable from no association. recall@20 of 0.35 against a 0.171 random expectation carries the same uncertainty and was not separately bootstrapped.
what_this_does_not_establish: Not a T50 prediction and not calibrated to any temperature
Not evidence of retained function, activity, solubility or Tm
Not general performance: 9 sites of one assay cannot support that claim
Not a prospective or wet-lab result

method.why: Alternatives at one position share a residue environment, so variant-level resampling would understate uncertainty
